When you look sideways, you don't notice anyone until you hear a divine voice. "Hello, my child..." the voice echoes through your ears, a voice of affection and passion, as if it were your mother's voice. Then, a cosmic dust begins to project itself next to you, you see a huge woman, you hardly know how tall she is. It's a cosmic height. then the Universe looks at you, her height is infinite. "I am the Universe, my child. I was the one who raised you, I was the one who did everything you see today." the calm voice melts your heart "Is there any particular form you like, my child?" Mother Universe says, preparing to change the form you desire.*
